title: W02c: repository source identity from the canonical common directory
description: Derive a deterministic source ID from the canonical Git common-directory filesystem location, resolving aliases with platform-aware canonicalization and without lowercasing case-sensitive directories. Linked worktrees of one repository share a source ID; separate clones are separate sources even when their remotes match; remote URLs are never identity and are never persisted. Moving a checkout changes its location-based identity while historical associations remain intact and verification at the new location is recorded separately.
acceptance: Linked worktrees of one repository produce one source ID, and two clones of the same remote produce two.
A recorded association keeps its original source ID after the checkout moves, and verification at the new location is recorded as a new association.
Alias, junction, short-name and Windows case variants of one path cannot produce two source IDs.
Remote URLs never appear in persisted identity or evidence.
notes: Acceptance group A02. Portable repository rebinding is explicitly out of scope for this release.
